name: drishti-app
//: @kolu/surface-app is NOT a bun dependency — like @kolu/surface, @kolu/surface-remote, @kolu/surface-map, @kolu/surface-daemon, and @kolu/surface-daemon-supervisor it is hydrated into node_modules/@kolu/* (raw .ts sources; no build step). Sourced hermetically from the npins-pinned kolu tree (npins/sources.json → kolu): nix/overlay.nix extracts each as a nix-store path, nix/env.nix exports $DRISHTI_KOLU_*, and the dev shell / install recipe / build derivation copy them into node_modules. Runtime dependencies of those hydrated sources are declared here; neverthrow carries Surface Remote's explicit agent-source result, quick-lru bounds its successful derivation cache, split2 frames child output, ts-pattern keeps its closed state folds exhaustive (and supervisor convergence), and dequal backs Surface Map's STRUCTURAL republish gate (kolu#2022). @kolu/solid-pwa-install is hydrated the same way. UW3: surface-daemon-supervisor powers convergeAdmit / probeDaemonIdentityFrom on the parent; the agent half lives in the agent package via surface-daemon.
